/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyAimGlide_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 飞身瞄准时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: To Aim Glide, hold down the Aim button <AIM_WEAPON> while in midair.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 在空中按住瞄准键<AIM_WEAPON>即可进行飞身瞄准。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyArtist_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Customize a piece of Equipment's colors.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 自定义一件装备的颜色。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyBulletJump_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 旋身飞跃 |COUNT| 次。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: To Bullet Jump, hold down the <HOLD_CROUCH>Crouch button, then tap <JUMP>Jump.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 按住<HOLD_CROUCH>下蹲键，再按<JUMP>跳跃键即可进行旋身飞跃。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyCodexScan_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 扫描 |COUNT| 次物件或敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Equip a scanner to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal, then activate it in a mission to equip it. While equipped, aim at enemies and hold <PRE_ATTACK> to scan them. You can buy Scanner charges from the Market or Cephalon Semaris.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 在军械库将扫描器添加到携带装备轮盘，然后在任务中启用它。装备时，瞄准敌人并按住<PRE_ATTACK>进行扫描。你可以从商店或中枢 Simaris 那里购买扫描器。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyCollectCredits_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 拾取 |COUNT| 现金。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Only credits dropped by enemies and containers count.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 只有敌人和容器掉落的现金才会被计入。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyCompleteMission_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 完成一场任务。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Start or join missions from the Navigation console.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 从导航控制台开始或加入任务。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyDeployGlyph_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Deploy a Glyph while on a mission.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 在任务中设置一枚浮印。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Equip a Glyph Prism to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal. To deploy it, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and select the Glyph Prism.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 在军械库装备浮印光谱到携带装备轮盘。要部署它，在任务中打开携带装备轮盘并选择浮印光谱。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemies_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Only enemies that you personally injured or killed are counted.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 只有你亲自击杀的敌人才会被计入。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithAbilities_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用技能击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Only enemies that you personally injured or killed with Abilities are counted.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 只有你亲自用技能击杀的敌人才会被计入。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithBlast_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用<DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_EXPLOSION>Blast Damage must be present. Blast Damage is formed by combining <DT_FIRE> and <DT_FREEZE>.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_EXPLOSION>爆炸伤害。爆炸伤害由 <DT_FIRE> 和 <DT_FREEZE> 组合而成。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithCorrosive_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用<DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_CORROSIVE>腐蚀伤害。腐蚀伤害由 <DT_ELECTRICITY> 和 <DT_POISON> 组合而成。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_ELECTRICITY>电击伤害。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithFinishers_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 处决击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Execute melee finishers on vulnerable enemies by sneaking upon them. Some Warframe abilities can also blind or stun enemies to enable finishers. Finishers on prone enemies do not count.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 通过潜行对毫无防备的敌人实施近战处决。某些战甲技能也可以致盲或眩晕敌人以进行处决。处决俯卧的敌人不会被计入。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithFire_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用<DT_FIRE>火焰伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_GAS>毒气伤害。毒气伤害由 <DT_FIRE> 和 <DT_POISON> 组合而成。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithHeadshots_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 爆头击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: The final hit must be on the head.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 最后一击必须要击中头部。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithMagnetic_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用<DT_MAGNETIC>磁力伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_MAGNETIC>磁力伤害。磁力伤害由 <DT_ELECTRICITY> 和 <DT_FREEZE> 组合而成。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithMelee_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Kill |COUNT| Enemies with a Melee Weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用近战武器击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Melee weapon count.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 只有你亲自使用近战武器击杀的敌人才会被计入。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithPoison_Name

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Kill |COUNT| Enemies with a Primary Weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用主要武器击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Primary weapon count.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 只有你亲自使用主要武器击杀的敌人才会被计入。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithRadiation_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用<DT_RADIATION>辐射伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: You can do other kinds of damage in the killing blow, but <DT_RADIATION>Radiation Damage must be present. Radiation Damage is formed by combining <DT_FIRE> and <DT_ELECTRICITY>.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_RADIATION>辐射伤害。辐射伤害由 <DT_FIRE> 和 <DT_ELECTRICITY> 组合而成。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithSecondary_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Kill |COUNT| Enemies with a Secondary Weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用次要武器击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Only enemies that you personally kill or injure with your Secondary weapon count.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 只有你亲自使用次要武器击杀的敌人才会被计入。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWithViral_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用<DT_VIRAL>病毒伤害击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 致命一击可包含其他类型的伤害，但必须有 <DT_VIRAL>病毒伤害。病毒伤害由 <DT_FREEZE> 和 <DT_POISON> 组合而成。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyPickUpEnergy_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 拾取 |COUNT| 个能量球。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Energy Orbs frequently drop from enemies and containers.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 能量球经常会从敌人和容器中掉落。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyPickUpMods_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 拾取 |COUNT| 个 Mod。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Mods frequently drop from enemies when they are killed.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 击杀敌人时经常会掉落 Mod。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyPlaceMarker_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 标记 |COUNT| 个 Mod 或资源。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Point directly at a Mod or Resource and press your Place Marker key <SHOW_SECRET_1>.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 将准星直接指向一个 Mod 或资源，然后按下放置标记键<SHOW_SECRET_1>。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyPlayEmote_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用 |COUNT| 个表情动作。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Emotes can be assigned on the Gear Tab in the Arsenal. To play an Emote, open the Gear Wheel during a mission and then swap to the Emotes Wheel.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 在军械库的装备栏设置表情动作。要使用表情动作，请在任务期间打开携带装备轮盘，然后切换到表情动作选单。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailySlideKills_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 滑行时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: To Slide, start moving, then hold <HOLD_CROUCH>Crouch.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 移动时按住 <HOLD_CROUCH> 下蹲键即可滑行。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyKillEnemiesWhileOnKDrive_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Kill |COUNT| enemies while riding a K-Drive, Kaithe, Velocipod, or Atomicycle.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 骑乘 K 式悬浮板、绝灵骥、迅敏节虫或原子摩托车时击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: You can equip your Secondary weapon while riding a K-Drive (or other vehicle) by pressing <SWITCH_GUN>. K-Drives are earned from the Vox Solaris Quest. Equip your K-Drive (or vehicle of choice) to the Gear Wheel, and then deploy it in Open Landscape missions.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 骑乘 K 式悬浮板（或其他载具）时，按下<SWITCH_GUN>即可装备你的次要武器。K 式悬浮板可以通过《索拉里斯之声》系列任务获得。将你的 K 式悬浮板（或所选载具）装备到携带装备轮盘上，即可在开放世界任务中部署。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyLiquidation_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Sell any item in your Inventory for Credits.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 出售仓库中的任意物品以获取现金。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyTwoForOne_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Pierce and kill 2 or more enemies in a single Bow shot.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 在单次弓箭射击中射穿并杀死 2 名以上的敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailySwatter_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Kill |COUNT| Drones or Ospreys with your Melee Weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 使用近战武器击杀 |COUNT| 架无人机或鱼鹰。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyToppingOffTheTank_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Successfully defend an Excavator without allowing it to run out of power.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 成功防御挖掘机并且不让挖掘机耗尽能量。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyThePersonalTouch_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 在你的轨道飞行器中放置 1 个装饰物。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyBuildersTouch_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Claim an item from your Foundry.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 从铸造厂中领取一件物品。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyCompleteMissionMelee_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Complete a Mission with only a Melee Weapon equipped
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 仅装备近战武器来完成一场任务
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Visit your Arsenal to change your loadout and remove both your Primary and Secondary Weapons. With only your Melee Weapon equipped, complete any mission by going to Navigation in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 访问你的军械库来更改你的配置，取消装备你的主要和次要武器。仅装备近战武器，前往你轨道飞行器上的星图导航开始并完成任何任务。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonDailyCompleteMissionPrimary_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionEn: Complete a Mission with only a Primary Weapon equipped
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.descriptionZh: 仅装备主要武器来完成一场任务
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipEn: Visit your Arsenal to change your loadout and remove both your Melee and Secondary Weapons. With only your Primary Weapon equipped, complete any mission by going to Navigation in your Orbiter.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Daily/Se.tipZh: 访问你的军械库来更改你的配置，取消装备你的近战和次要武器。仅装备主要武器，前往你轨道飞行器上的星图导航开始并完成任何任务。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Bow.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 使用主要弓箭击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCatchRarePlainsFish_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Catch |COUNT| Rare Fish in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在夜灵平野捕捉 |COUNT| 条稀有鱼。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Murkray, Norg, Cuthol, and Glappid are considered to be rare fish. Hai-Luk in Cetus can supply you with fishing equipment. Equip your purchased Fishing Spear to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and then activate it while on the Plains. Use Bait in the correct water sources to find Rare Fish. Time of day can change how often certain fish appear, and some only appear at day or night.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 阴暗鳐、诺格、克苏尔，和盖拉佩德都属于稀有鱼类。希图斯的渔人海露可以为你提供捕鱼装备。在军械库中将你购买的鱼叉装备到携带装备轮盘，然后在平原上激活即可使用。在正确的水域使用鱼饵来寻找稀有鱼类。 一天中的不同时段会影响某些鱼类的出现频率，有些鱼类只在白天或夜晚出现。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCatchRareVenusFish_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Catch |COUNT| Rare Servofish in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在奥布山谷捕捉 |COUNT| 条稀有伺服鱼。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Synathid, Tromyzon, and Charamote are considered to be rare fish. The Business in Fortuna can supply you with fishing equipment. Add a Shock Spear to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and then activate it while in the Orb Vallis. Use Bait in the correct water sources in the correct weather conditions to find Rare Fish.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 海龙、多目鳗、和重筑虾都属于稀有鱼类。福尔图娜中的操盘手可以为你提供捕鱼装备。在军械库中将电击鱼叉装备到携带装备轮盘，然后在奥布山谷上激活即可使用。在正确的天气条件下和正确的水域使用鱼饵来寻找稀有鱼类。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteAssassination_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Nightmare missions spawn on planets once have completed all of the planet's nodes. Available Nightmare missions can be found in the Alert tab in the Navigation menu.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 一旦星球上的所有节点都完成，噩梦任务就会出现。可玩的噩梦任务在导航菜单的警报标签中找到。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteCapture_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Capture.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是捕获。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteClemMission_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Help Clem with his weekly mission.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 帮助 Clem 完成他的周常任务。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Darvo can be found in any Relay using the Fast Travel options in the pause menu. Select the "Does Clem need my help?" dialogue option after completing the A Man of Few Words quest.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 使用暂停菜单中的快速移动选项，即可在任意中继站中找到 Darvo。完成《沉默寡言的男人》系列任务后，选择「Clem 需要我的协助吗？」对话选项。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteExterminate_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Extermination.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是歼灭。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteInvasionMissions_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Complete |COUNT| Invasion missions of any type.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 完成 |COUNT| 项任何类型的入侵任务。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Active Invasion missions can be found in the Invasions Tab of the Navigation menu. Support a side in the chosen Invasion for 3 missions to earn the listed Battle Pay.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 进行中的入侵任务可以在导航菜单的入侵标签中找到。在所选的入侵任务中支持一方并完成 3 个任务，即可获得列出的战区报酬。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteMobileDefense_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 完成 |COUNT| 项移动防御任务。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Mobile Defense.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是移动防御。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteNightmareMissions_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Complete |COUNT| Nightmare missions of any type.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 完成 |COUNT| 项任何类型的噩梦任务。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Nightmare missions spawn on planets once have completed all of the planet's nodes. Available Nightmare missions can be found in the Alert tab in the Navigation menu.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 一旦星球上的所有节点都完成，噩梦任务就会出现。可玩的噩梦任务在导航菜单的警报标签中找到。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteRescue_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Rescue.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是救援。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteSabotage_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Sabotage.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是破坏。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteSortie_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Select the Sortie from the World State panel in Navigation. You must finish all three missions.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 在星图的世界状态面板中选择突击任务。你必须完成所有三项任务。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteSpy_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start new missions from the Navigation console. The mission type must be Spy.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 从导航控制台开始新任务。任务类型必须是间谍。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteSyndicateMissions_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Syndicate missions become available once you haved Pledged to a Syndicate via the segment in your Base of Operations. Syndicate Pledging is unlocked upon reaching Mastery Rank 3. Use the Syndicate tab in the Navigation Menu to find active Syndicate missions.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 在你的行动基地中，通过集团模块向集团宣誓效忠，即可解锁集团任务。集团效忠功能在达到精通段位 3 时解锁。使用星图导航中的集团标签页下寻找进行中的任务。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyCompleteTreasures_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Look for Ayatan Treasures for Maroo in Maroo's Bazaar.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在 Maroo 的市集寻找 Maroo 的阿耶檀识宝物。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Visit Maroo in Maroo's Bazaar on Mars. Ask her about Ayatan Treasures and she will send you on a mission to retrieve one. You can socket Ayatan Stars into Sculptures by clicking the Ayatan Treasures button in the Mods workbench. Stars are uncommon items found in containers, while Sculptures are hidden items to search out during missions.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 在火星上 Maroo 的市集里拜访 Maroo。向她询问有关阿耶檀识宝物的情况，她会派你去完成一场取回宝物的任务。你可以在 Mod 操作台中的阿耶檀识宝物按钮，来将阿耶檀识之星插入到塑像中。阿耶檀识之星是罕见物品，可通过开启任务中的容器获得。而塑像则是需要在任务中专门寻找的隐藏物品。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyKillEnemiesWithHeadshots_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: The final hit must be on the head.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 最后一击必须要击中头部。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyMineRarePlainsResources_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Mine |COUNT| Rare Gems or Ore in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在夜灵平野中开采到 |COUNT| 次稀有宝石或矿石。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: The vendor Old Man Suumbaat in Cetus can supply you with mining equipment. Add a mining tool to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and activate it while on the Plains. Look for glowing minerals on rocks and carefully drill each weak point.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 希图斯的老者松巴可以为你提供采矿装备。在军械库装备一件采矿工具到携带装备轮盘，并在平野启用它。寻找岩石上发光的矿物质，并仔细钻探每一个薄弱点。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyMineRareVenusResources_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Mine |COUNT| Rare Gems or Ore in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在奥布山谷中开采到 |COUNT| 次稀有宝石或矿石。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: The vendor Smokefinger in Fortuna can supply you with mining equipment. Add a mining tool to your Gear Wheel in the Arsenal and activate it while on the Orb Vallis. Look for glowing minerals on rocks and carefully drill each weak point.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 福尔图娜的烟指可以为你提供采矿装备。在军械库装备一件采矿工具到携带装备轮盘，并在奥布山谷启用它。寻找岩石上发光的矿物质，并仔细钻探每一个薄弱点。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyPerfectAnimalCapture_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Complete |COUNT| different Perfect Animal Captures in Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在奥布山谷完成 |COUNT| 个不同动物的完美捕获。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Conservation requires the Tranq Rifle and Echo-Lures, which can be obtained from The Business in Fortuna. Equip these items to your Gear Wheel via the Arsenal. Once in the Orb Vallis, equip the Tranq Rifle or Echo-lure and check the Advanced Map for starting points to begin your hunt. Perfect Captures require the animal to be Tranquilized without it seeing you or being injured.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 保育需要麻醉步枪和回声诱饵，这些物品可以从福尔图娜中的操盘手处获得。通过军械库将这些物品装备到你的携带装备轮盘。进入奥布山谷后，装备麻醉步枪或是回声诱饵，并查看进阶地图来寻找狩猎的起始点。完美捕获要求动物在没有发现你或受伤的情况下被麻醉。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyPerplexed_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在双衍王境中完成 1 个谜题

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyPickUpMedallion_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Find |COUNT| Syndicate Medallions. You can search by yourself or with a squad.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 找到 |COUNT| 集团奖章。可以自己搜索，也可以组队搜索。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyPlainsBounties_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Complete |COUNT| Bounties in the Plains of Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在夜灵平野完成 |COUNT| 个赏金任务。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start Bounties by either talking to Konzu in Cetus or going directly to the Plains of Eidolon and finding Bounty Source outposts.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 赏金任务可以通过与希图斯的孔尊交谈，或是直接前往夜灵平野，并找到一处赏金任务前哨战来开始。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklySabotageCaches_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在任意任务中找到 |COUNT| 个储藏箱。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Resource Caches can appear as a secondary objective, meaning they will be listed as an optional objective if they spawned in the mission. Eligible missions include various types of Sabotage missions, but they can also be found in Lua Exterminate and Kuva Exterminate missions, and in certain Bounty objectives on Open Landscapes.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 资源储藏箱可能会作为次要目标出现。若其在任务中生成，则会被列为可选目标。可出现资源储藏箱的任务包括各种破坏任务，以及月球歼灭、赤毒歼灭任务，和开放世界中的特定赏金任务目标上。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyRifleOffense_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 使用主要步枪击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklySanctuaryOnslaught_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 完成 |COUNT| 个圣殿突袭的区域。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start Sanctuary Onslaught from the World State panel in Navigation after completing The New Strange quest. The 8 zones do not need to be completed in a single session.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 完成《新疑谜团》系列任务后，即可在星图的世界状态面板中开始圣殿突袭任务。不需要在单场任务中完成 8 个区域。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyShotgunOffense_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Shotgun.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 使用主要霰弹枪击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklySimarisScan_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 完成 |COUNT| 个中枢 Simaris 的扫描。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Request a Synthesis assignment from Cephalon Simaris on a Relay and find the assigned enemy type. You can acquire Synthesis Scanner charges from his Offerings.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 在中继站通过中枢 Simaris 接下结合仪式任务，并找到指定类型的敌人。你可以从他的声望奖励获取结合扫描器。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklySniperOffense_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Kill |COUNT| enemies with a Primary Sniper Rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 使用主要狙击步枪击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyUnlockDragonVaults_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Unlock |COUNT| Dragon Key vaults on Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 解锁 |COUNT| 个火卫二龙钥宝库。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Orokin Vaults are found in Orokin Derelict tileset missions on Deimos. There are four different Dragon Keys, of which one random kind is used to unlock the Vault. The correct Dragon Key must be equipped on your Gear Wheel during the mission to unlock it. Multilpe keys can be equipped at a time if desired, or different keys can be carried by squadmates. Obtain Dragon Key blueprints via Clan Dojo research, then build them in the Foundry.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 奥罗金宝库可以在火卫二的奥罗金遗迹场景的任务中找到。一共有四种不同的龙钥，会随机使用其中一种来解锁宝库。任务中必须将正确的龙钥装备在你的携带装备轮盘中才能解锁宝库。如果需要，可以同时装备多个龙钥，或由小队成员携带不同的龙钥。龙钥蓝图可以通过在氏族道场研究获得，然后在铸造厂进行制造。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyUnlockRelics_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start Void Fissure missions from Navigation and make sure you equip a Relic. Unlock the Relic by picking up Reactant dropped from killed enemies.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 可以从星图进行虚空裂缝任务，并确保你装备了遗物。通过捡起被击杀的敌人掉落的反应物来解开遗物。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyUseForma_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Polarize a Weapon, Companion, or Warframe (not in Simulacrum).
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 极化一个武器、同伴或战甲（不在幻影装置中）。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Forma blueprints are earned from Void Relics, or built Forma can be obtained from the Market or various vendors throughout the Origin System. Once acquired, open the equipment's Upgrade menu in the Arsenal, and select Actions to Polarize the item with Forma. Installing Forma applies a new Polarity Slot, which reduces the cost of matching Polarity Mods installed in that Slot.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: Forma 蓝图可以通用虚空遗物获得，或者也可以在游戏内商店或始源星系各地的商人那里获得成品 Forma。获得后，在军械库打开装备的升级菜单中，选择指令按钮来用 Forma 对装备进行极化。安装 Forma 会赋予槽位新的极性，可减少安装在该槽位上与之相符极性 Mod 的容量消耗。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.name: /Lotus/Language/NightwaveChallenges/Challenge_SeasonWeeklyVenusBounties_Name
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionEn: Complete |COUNT| Bounties in the Orb Vallis.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 在奥布山谷完成 |COUNT| 个赏金任务。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Start Bounties by either talking to Eudico in Fortuna or going directly to the Orb Vallis and finding a Solaris contact to speak to.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 通过与福尔图娜的 Eudico 交谈，或是直接前往奥布山谷，并找到可与之交谈的索拉里斯联系人来开始赏金任务。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 向 Helminth 饲喂任意资源。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Obtain the Helminth Segment Blueprint from Son in the Necralisk after reaching Rank 3 with the Entrati. Feed resources to fuel various Secretions, which are then consumed by engaging with the Helminth system. Reset the Helminth's appetite for certain resources by feeding it items from the Sentient Appetite category.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 达到英择谛声望等级 3 后，可以从殁世幽都的"儿子"处获得 Helminth 模块蓝图。饲喂资源以产生各种分泌物，这些会在使用 Helminth 系统时被消耗掉。饲喂 Sentient 资源可以重置 Helminth 对特定资源的食欲。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.descriptionZh: 使用殁世机甲击杀 |COUNT| 名敌人。
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipEn: Summon your owned Necramech in eligible missions using the Necramech Summon on your Gear Wheel. If you do not own a Necramech, you can commandeer a Necramech using Transference (after The War Within quest) in the Cambion Drift while Fass is dominant.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/Weekly/S.tipZh: 在符合条件的任务中，使用携带装备轮盘上的召唤殁世机甲来召唤你拥有的殁世机甲。如果你尚未拥有殁世机甲，你可以在魔胎之境当"混乱"占据主导地位时，使用传识（需要完成《内战》系列任务）来征用殁世机甲。

/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/WeeklyHa.tipEn: This game mode is accessed from the Navigation console in your Orbiter or by visiting Kahl's Garrison in the Drifter's Camp. Archon Hunts are a set of three missions with the following restrictions; no self-revives, no use of deployable allies, and Squad Restores have a long cooldown. To begin the Hunt, you need a Rank 30 Warframe or a Warframe that has been polarized at least once if you are Mastery Rank 30 (or higher). Prepare your Arsenal to take on challenging enemies (level 130 and higher).  Completing the first two missions will bring you to the third and final Assassination mission, where you will face the currently active Archon.
/Lotus/Types/Challenges/Seasons/WeeklyHa.tipZh: 这个游戏模式可以从轨道飞行器的导航控制台或漂流者营地的卡尔驻军访问。执刑官猎杀是一组的三个任务，有以下任务限制：不能自我复活，不能使用可部署的盟友，而且团队补给有很长的冷却时间。要开始猎杀，你需要一个等级 30 的战甲，或者如果你是精通段位 30（或更高）则需要一个至少极化过一次的战甲。准备好你的军械库，来迎接颇具挑战性的敌人（130 级及更高级别）。完成前两个任务将带你进入第三个也是最后一个刺杀任务，在那里你将面对当前活跃的执刑官。

可以设置 UMBRA 极性的 Forma。
